Definition: a mongrel, i.e. born of a Jewish father and a heathen mother
BiblicalUsage: 1) bastard, child of incest, illegitimate child; 1a) bastard; 1b) mixed population (fig.); 1c) born of a Jewish father and a heathen mother or visa versa
